quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his confidence and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I was just confident. Short-term memory. I wanted to win. My teammates did a great job.
quotes.quote: I was just confident. Short-term memory. I wanted to win. My teammates did a great job, putting me in positions to be successful. Coaches did the same and down the stretch of the game, we were getting stops and that led to me and my teammates scoring.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries credits his teammates and coaches for his success down the stretch saying they did a great job putting him in positions to be successful

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on impacting the game beyond scoring
quotes.excerpt: Just continue to find other ways to win, impact the game of winning outside of scoring.
quotes.quote: Just continue to find other ways to win, impact the game of winning outside of scoring. Beginning the game, I hit two shots, then I missed a few, and then coming on the bench, just trying to stay confident, trying to be a great teammate now. And then when I get back out there, just defend, rebound, impact the game outside of just scoring.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says he is focused on impacting the game beyond scoring by trying to defend and rebound when his shot is not falling

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on the importance of fourth-quarter confidence
quotes.excerpt: It is super important for me, for confidence, knowing that I can play at this level.
quotes.quote: It is super important for me, for confidence, knowing that I can play at this level, compete and impact the game on both sides of the ball and rebounding. It is super important for sure. But you know, the main thing, the best thing about me I think is with my mindset is just never get too high, never get too low. Just stay confident. I feel like this stuff is going to take time, come with patience and experience. So once I get the experience, I will be fine.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on his rookie mindset saying the best thing about him is never getting too high or too low and staying confident as he gains experience
